This directory presents concrete C++ algorithmic optimizations integrated directly into OpenROAD's Clock Tree Synthesis (src/cts/) and Timing Resizing (src/rsz/) engines. Below are the complete source diffs, integrated micro-kernels, candidate policy parameter variations, and comprehensive performance metrics.
